title: Cancellation Terms for In-Person Appointments
content:
**Section 1. Right to cancel.** A patient may cancel an open In-Person Appointments appointment at any time before check-in; the cancellation is recorded with its timing.

**Section 2. Timely and late patient cancellations.** The following sentence of these terms is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for classifying patient cancellations: *"A patient cancellation is timely when the full elapsed hours from the moment of cancellation to the scheduled start (the scheduled date and time, clinic local time) are at least the visit type's cancellation notice hours, and late otherwise."* The visit type's cancellation notice figure itself remains the figure in the fee schedule.

**Section 3. Cancellations made by the clinic.** A cancellation made by the clinic, for example because the clinician is unavailable, the clinic is closed, there is a weather closure, an authorization is missing or an unconfirmed appointment is released, is recorded as clinic initiated and never carries a fee. The clinic offers a replacement slot within the visit type's priority replacement period in business days.

**Section 4. Late arrival beyond the check-in limit.** A patient who arrives more than the visit type's late-arrival limit in minutes after the scheduled start cannot be checked in, and the visit is cancelled with the reason late arrival and the timing late.

**Section 5. Charging a late cancellation.** The following sentence is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis: *"A late cancellation is charged the visit type's late-cancellation fee unless the fee-waiver rules remove it."*

**Section 6. When a late-cancellation fee may be assessed.** A late-cancellation fee is assessed only when the cancellation was recorded with timing late. The appointment's own system record is the authority: the timing stored on that appointment is what is read, for that appointment.

**Section 7. Cancelling in order to rebook.** The following sentence is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis: *"A request to cancel less than the cancellation notice hours before the start in order to rebook is a late cancellation of this appointment followed by a new booking, never a reschedule."*

### Timing recorded on the appointment, at a glance

| Who or what ended the visit | Timing recorded | Fee under these terms |
|---|---|---|
| The clinic (closure, clinician unavailable, missing authorization, unconfirmed release) | Clinic initiated | Never |
| A late arrival past the late-arrival limit | Late | A late-cancellation fee may be assessed, the timing being late |
| The patient | The timing class the cancellation is given | A late-cancellation fee only where the timing recorded is late |

*Hypothetical case:* a Nurse Visit is cancelled because the clinician is unavailable; it is recorded as clinic initiated, carries no fee, and the patient is offered a replacement slot within the visit type's priority replacement period.

superseded_clauses: A patient cancellation is timely when the full elapsed hours from the moment of cancellation to the scheduled start (scheduled_date and scheduled_time, clinic local time) are at least the visit type's cancel_notice_hours, and late otherwise.
A request to cancel less than cancel_notice_hours before the start in order to rebook is a late cancellation of this appointment followed by a new booking, never a reschedule.
A late cancellation is charged the visit type's late_cancel_fee_usd unless appointment_fee_waiver removes it.
